description: This file defines Pydantic data models for exercise logs and body metrics, including creation and output schemas, used in a gym management backend API.

classes.name: ExerciseLogCreate
classes.description: Payload schema for creating a new exercise log for the current user.

classes.name: ExerciseLogOut
classes.description: Response schema for an exercise log, including metadata like creation and update timestamps.

classes.name: BodyMetricsCreate
classes.description: Payload schema for creating a body metrics snapshot for the current user.

classes.name: BodyMetricsOut
classes.description: Response schema for body metrics, including metadata like timestamps.
